I recently took my dogs, Hashie and Mya, to Dog Grooming USA, and I couldn't be more pleased with the experience. From the moment we walked in, the staff was incredibly welcoming and professional. The groomers took the time to listen to my specific requests and made sure to address any concerns I had about my dog's grooming needs.

The facility itself was spotless, with a calm and soothing atmosphere that made me feel comfortable leaving my pup in their care. My dogs were a little nervous at first, but the groomers were very patient, and it was clear that they truly care about the pets they work with.

When I picked up Hashie and Mya they looked fantastic—beautifully trimmed, clean, and smelling great. What really impressed me was how well they handled my dog's specific needs, as he/she has sensitive skin, and I was worried about any reactions to grooming products. However, everything went smoothly.

Overall, I highly recommend Dog Grooming USA for anyone looking for quality grooming services. Their attention to detail, caring attitude, and professionalism truly set them apart. I’ll definitely be back for our next grooming session!
